liebermann.description_de: Posteriores chartae Londonienses a. 1155. 1199, quibus Henrici I. verba repetuntur
liebermann.shelfmark_as_given: The later royal charters for London (1155, 1199), which repeat the words of Henry I’s charter
liebermann.notes: Not a manuscript: Liebermann’s siglum for the charters granted to London by Henry II (1155) and Richard I (1199), which repeat Henry I’s wording and so serve as witnesses to the text of Hn Lond.
